reviews.text:
⭐️ 1 STAR

Extremely disappointing experience. One of the dress I received arrived dusty, dirty, and looking old and worn. It was honestly shocking to receive an item in this condition.

I contacted customer service, but they refused to accept the return because it was “final sale.” I understand the policy, but sending a customer an item in unacceptable condition and then refusing to help is incredibly frustrating.

This was one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. I’ve spent a lot of money with Alo Yoga, but after this experience, I will seriously reconsider ordering from this brand again.

reviews.title: Gift Card
reviews.text: I’m extremely disappointed with Alo’s customer service. I had a gift card that I wanted to use toward my order, only to be told I couldn’t use it because the items were on sale. A gift card is money that has already been paid to the company, so I don’t understand why purchasing sale items would prevent me from using it. Sales should be an opportunity to make customers happy, not an excuse to make it more difficult to use a gift card. This experience left a bad impression and has made me think twice about shopping with Alo in the future. I expected better from a brand at this price point.

reviews.title: Inventory Issue Causing Misleading Gift Promises in ALO App
reviews.text:
I want to share feedback about the ALO app because it needs improvement. If a welcome gift is added to the cart, it should only happen when the item is actually in stock. The same should apply to the ALO Wellness System gift. If the gift is out of stock, it should not be displayed or added to the order. Instead, a different reward should be offered, or nothing should be added at all.

In my case, the gift was added and then later canceled, and I did not receive anything. That creates a frustrating customer experience and feels misleading.

reviews.title: Birthday gift
reviews.text: I made a purchase this month, and because it was my birthday, I was supposed to receive a birthday gift. The purchase arrived at my house, but the gift never did. And I never received any message or email about it. I contacted the Alo team and they told me that the gift didn't arrive because it was out of stock, so they offered me a 10% discount on my next purchase. I didn't accept it because I don't think it's fair. They have a program where you earn points and get a gift on your birthday if you make a purchase, which is what I did. It's not my fault if they didn't have the gift; they could have sent something else, I guess. I honestly think this is all a lack of consideration for their customers; they really don't care about their customers. I AM FRUSTRATED WITH THIS SITUATION!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The customer service is lacking substantially. I’ve attempted numerous times to use my reward points, including being on the phone with a rep for over 90 minutes only to be told there is nothing that can be done. If you’re going to make the reward points expire then you better be offering sufficient items to redeem reward points on. This is very manipulative and deceiving. I enjoy Alo products, however working with such rudimentary customer service is such a disappointment.

reviews.title: App Glitches
reviews.text: The app is unreliable. Limited options for items to redeem points with. When you do find something, I would like to shop for something I like but by the time I go back to redeem the items are gone. At times it removes items from my cart that are still available so I’m constantly re-adding. Overall, not happy with Alo’s lack of items to redeem and glitches with the app. Lulu has a better system and they are at a lower price range than Alo.

reviews.title: Please clean up the inventory reconciliations.
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the delivery process and the overall experience with the ALO website. In October, there was a 30% discount, and I was excited because I had been wanting to order the beige ribbed set, the top and the pants, for a long time. I placed the order through the app, and there were only a few items left in stock, so I managed to get them just in time. The top arrived within a few days, which was great.

However, the app then informed me that the pants were delayed and would be shipped later as the second part of the order. I waited for a long time. Later, the app showed that the pants were out of stock, and that I had to wait until they were restocked. Then a restock date started appearing, but it has kept getting pushed further and further back.

I contacted customer support three times, because I ordered pants that were in stock, not a preorder. Support apologized, but said they couldn’t help. One agent even suggested filing a “lost package” claim, so that I could receive the pants faster. I waited a week, but nothing happened. Today, I contacted support again and was told that it’s impossible to file a lost-package claim for an item that is considered a preorder and has not been shipped. I asked them not to promise customers faster shipping through a lost-package claim if that option doesn’t apply to preorder items.

Today they once again told me they would do everything they can. I truly hope these pants arrive at least by the end of this year. I neede
